title: Cost-aware AWS preflight for T-2 EKS baseline
objective: Prepare the private EKS Terraform baseline for a bounded real-AWS validation without creating any cloud resource in this task.

include: Kubernetes version update to a standard-supported EKS version
private VPC endpoint design for required node bootstrap services

acceptance: No resource is created or changed in AWS
The baseline avoids EKS extended-support cost
Private node bootstrap dependencies and non-goals are explicit
A later apply task has a bounded teardown plan
